# Tensorlake

Sign up at [cloud.tensorlake.ai](https://cloud.tensorlake.ai/), run `pip install tensorlake` for the Python SDK, install the CLI with `curl -sSL https://tensorlake.ai/install.sh | sh`, set your `TENSORLAKE_API_KEY`, and create your first sandbox - see the [guides](https://docs.tensorlake.ai) for the full walkthrough.
